text: Digital sci-fi illustration of a futuristic desert at dusk, wide cinematic shot. On a rippled sand dune in the left foreground, a man in a dark red cape stands next to a brown llama, both viewed from behind facing a distant city. In the right foreground, a saguaro cactus outlined in glowing pink neon stands beside a glowing turquoise pond, with a smaller dark cactus to its right. An elevated, orange-lit monorail track with a sleek silver train curves from the bottom right across the dunes toward the city. In the center-right background, a cyberpunk metropolis rises with three towering spires: a central spire encircled by a glowing cyan halo ring, a left spire displaying a vertical cyan neon sign reading "OASIS", and a right spire lit in purple, above tiered circular buildings and four diagonal cyan spotlights. The sky transitions from starry deep blue at top-left to a warm orange horizon, featuring a large crescent moon in the upper left.
